text: An exact-tree query benchmark exposed allocator-sensitive RSS inflation because the memory sampler covered the materialized timing comparator as well as the query-first paths. The gate now uses a second fresh child, warms all routes, and measures only selected RDM, full fused RDM, and RSA; the comparator remains timing-only. The regenerated receipt passes at 434,470,912 bytes incremental RSS with 4.44e-16 oracle error.
